eyebrow: Cloud Deployment, Monitoring, Backup & Job-Ready Capstone · Chapter 2
subtitle: Lesson 6 · Deploying the Network Layer

code:
az group create --name rg-prod --location eastus

az network vnet create \
  --resource-group rg-prod --name vnet-prod \
  --address-prefix 10.0.0.0/16 \
  --subnet-name snet-web --subnet-prefix 10.0.1.0/24

az network vnet subnet create \
  --resource-group rg-prod --vnet-name vnet-prod \
  --name snet-app --address-prefixes 10.0.2.0/24
caption: One /16 VNet, then a web and app subnet carved out of it.

code:
aws ec2 create-vpc --cidr-block 10.0.0.0/16 --region us-east-1

aws ec2 create-subnet \
  --vpc-id vpc-0abc123456789def0 \
  --cidr-block 10.0.1.0/24 \
  --availability-zone us-east-1a

aws ec2 create-subnet \
  --vpc-id vpc-0abc123456789def0 \
  --cidr-block 10.0.2.0/24 \
  --availability-zone us-east-1a
caption: Same /16 VPC, same web/app split — different CLI, same plan.
